title: Evaluation of a constructed distribution
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a finite type, and let $f:\alpha\to\bbr$ be nonnegative at every outcome and have total sum $1$. For every $a\in\alpha$, the probability assigned to $a$ by the distribution constructed from $f$ is $f(a)$.
